title: AISE model/version identifiers (v1.0)
description: Interchange identifiers for derived engineering model versions. Versions are monotonic per model; reprocessing creates new derived versions and never erases prior ones (architecture-lock 2.10). The Reality Graph remains the only canonical authority for model content (architecture-lock 1); these identifiers only name versions and objects for cross-platform reference. Object identity is stable within a model version (requirements AC-042).

parentVersion.title: Version this version was derived from (lineage)

modelObjectRef.title: Reference to one object within a model version
modelObjectRef.description: objectId is stable within its model version (requirements AC-042). Cross-version object stability is NOT promised by v1.0.

objectId.title: Stable object identifier scoped to one model version
